    @pytest.mark.priority(18)
    def test_validate_sequentially_accessedCourse_fromCoachesPortal(self):
        allure.dynamic.title(
        f"Given when user access a sequentially delivered course from user portal"
        f"then when coach should see the user's progress in coaches portal for that user"
    )
        """Validate sequential access progress for a user in coaches portal."""
        self.driver.get(f"{self.coaches_url}app/cohort/automationForLearn/users/6628aedb2c6bf00001e7738b/course")
        status_xpath = "//div[@class='_label_1rry3_10']"
        WebDriverWait(self.driver, 15).until(lambda d: len(d.find_elements(By.XPATH, status_xpath)) >= 4)
    
        passedStatus = self.driver.find_elements(By.XPATH, status_xpath)
        assert len(passedStatus) >= 4, f"Expected at least 4 status labels, got {len(passedStatus)}"
        assert passedStatus[0].text.strip() != "0%", f"Expected first content to show progress, got '{passedStatus[0].text}'"
        assert passedStatus[1].text.strip() == "0%", f"Expected first content to show progress, got '{passedStatus[0].text}'"
        third_card_xpath = "(//div[@class='card-header'])[3]"
